scenes.text: Need a Halloween plan in Miami this weekend without circling the same places?
Start with Miami New Times. They ran a Halloween weekend party guide on Monday, October 26, 2026.
scenes.caption: Start with Miami New Times. They ran a Halloween weekend party guide on Monday, Oct. 26, 2026.

scenes.text: For a second check, Miami New Times also published The Best Halloween Parties in Miami 2025 on Friday, October 31, 2025. That gives you another list to compare before you pick a spot. If you’re torn, open NEAR and see who’s heading there too.
scenes.caption: Miami New Times also published The Best Halloween Parties in Miami 2025 on Friday, Oct. 31, 2025. If you’re torn, open NEAR and see who’s heading there too.

scenes.text: If you want a stop with food and nightlife, DC Pie Co. and Dom's are at 1010 Brickell Ave #200 in Miami. On October 31, kids 12 and under in costume get a free personal pizza with a purchase, and Dom's runs Trick or Tequila from 5 p.m. with a costume contest, tequila specials, and a DJ.

scenes.text: Send the one that fits your group chat first. Spotted someone in a costume at the rave and never caught their name? NEAR is the app that shows you who that person was after the night ends.
